declaration: Single supplement chosen after observing ordinary completion with high idle actions and poor strict completion in the first combined controller. No result from this appended comparison was read before this protocol freeze. No further arms or threshold choices.

collection.shared_prefix: Exactly original assisted offsets0..63 from CP131072; actual changing historical model actions, teacher labels, observations and world endpoints verified. Endpoint147456-frozen backbone continuously replays the same observations from actual CP131072 h.
collection.midpoint: Actual assisted world after first64 blocks; continuous frozen-backbone h must match the saved original readout fit reconstruction hash. Original changing-model h separately verified against block64 start_h.
collection.assisted_archive: Replay exact original assisted offsets64..127 with archived executed actions and midpoint labels; features continue the same frozen backbone h, never reset.
collection.own_policy: From identical midpoint world and frozen-backbone h, execute the already fitted non_input24 BEGIN+conditionalFINISH eleven-way argmax for64x128 ticks. Midpoint teacher labels are read only and never intervene. Original combined model state must match saved model.pt exactly.
collection.actors: Run full actual8-actor world; fit only actors0..3 as before.
collection.equality: Both added halves32768 positions per job, same8192 ticks and actors0..3; external scheduler/event hashes, command exposures and request identities must match.
collection.persistence: Save collected observations, own executed actions, teacher labels, continuous frozen features, request sets and per-block causal endpoint hashes.

fit.dataset: Same old first32768+new/archive32768=65536 positions per seed/job in each matched arm.
fit.algorithm: Direct readout.fit plus finish_readout.train_finish; same non_input24 features, original WAIT=.1/nonWAIT=1 weights, train-only population scaling, zero initialization, slopeL2=.001 and original LBFGS settings.
fit.conditional: Keep teacher non-BEGIN rows for9-way WAIT+FINISH exactly as original. Report resulting filtered row counts and actual iterations; equal data opportunity budget and identical optimizer caps, not forced equal convergence iterations.

evaluation.source: Common actual147456 complete endpoint h/world and endpoint-frozen backbone, not either collection endpoint h/world.
evaluation.anchor: SHA-bound original combined non_input24 unrefit controller forks; anchor has half the training positions and is descriptive, not the budget-matched contrast.
evaluation.policy: Unmodified existing combined group-first BEGIN/conditionalFINISH controller, full11 argmax. No teacher, private state gates, target forcing or parameter updates at deployment.
evaluation.matching: Exact primary matured request identities and external scheduler/event streams across both refits and unrefit anchor; future test requests disjoint from all fit requests.
metrics: feasible accepted BEGIN per primary matured
all idle actions per actual inactive opportunity
false idle BEGIN, duplicate BEGIN and total BEGIN/FINISH attempts
legally timed FINISH and accepted FINISH
evaluation.multiple_attempts: Report attempts per matured and accepted FINISH, duplicate BEGIN, idle action counts and strict completion so ordinary completion is not presented as clean execution.

limits: One externally supervised policy-data correction, not native recurrent learning.
Only readout fitting holds actors4..7 out; original backbone training saw all8 actors.
On-policy labels and receipts change together; comparison tests the collected training distribution as a whole, not one isolated feature.
Three paired seeds, fixed optimizer settings and one supplement; no selection by results.
